subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app performs avoidable idle polling and animation wakeups

question: Should maintainers land the linked event-driven macOS idle-wakeup fix now, or require additional signed connected-state registration-refresh proof first?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and has an open candidate fix, but the protected maintainer label and disclosed live connected-state proof gap require owner judgment before the issue can close.

options.title: Review and land the candidate fix
options.body: Accept the current signed-app idle proof plus source review, land the linked PR, and let GitHub close this issue when it merges.

options.title: Request one more connected-state proof run
options.body: Ask for a signed macOS run that observes connected-state node registration refresh before deciding whether to land the PR.

options.title: Replace the candidate fix
options.body: Keep this issue open and close or supersede the linked PR only if maintainers prefer a different macOS scheduling design.

recommendation.title: Review and land the candidate fix
recommendation.body: Accept the current signed-app idle proof plus source review, land the linked PR, and let GitHub close this issue when it merges.
